Eligibility of Tenderer : Tender must meet the following qualifying and other eligibility criteria stated in the Tender Documents.
1. The Tenderer shall have a minimum of 05 (Five) years of Overall experience in supply of Equipment and related services.
2. Minimum Specific experience as supplier in supply of similar Goods of at single contract(s) successfully completion within the
last 03 (Three) Years, with a value of at least Tk. 12.50 Lakh
3. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities shall be Tk. 14 Lakh. (Certificate for proving available
liquid assets must be issued within 28 (twenty eight) days from the date of tender submission).
4. The tenderer must also have Update Income Tax certificate (2016-2017), Trade License (2017-2018) and VAT Registration
certificate.
5. Proof of Works Completion Certificate for similar kind of Supply.
6. Manufacturers Authorization Letter must be submitted
7. All others as stated in the tender documents.
